idle: standing still in a relaxed rest pose, facing the viewer
step-a: mid-walk, left foot forward, small bounce
step-b: mid-walk, right foot forward, small bounce
sit: sitting down on an invisible chair, hands or paws on an invisible table
happy: happy, eyes closed, little smile, small hop
eat: eating, holding food up to the mouth
wave: waving one hand or paw at the viewer
talk: talking, mouth open, one hand raised
